suppress.notes: AndroidX SQLite 2.5.1 is a Java API wrapper over the Android framework SQLite implementation; the 2015-5895 database is a CPE match for old upstream SQLite releases, not a version carried by these AndroidX artifacts. The release APK DEX files contain no androidx/sqlite classes. Re-evaluate if the SQLite implementation or APK reachability changes.
